responsibility: Implements MSP430 ABI classification by extending scalars to 16 bits and lowering aggregates larger than 32 bits to indirect passing and return in the function ABI.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/msp430.rs`, this file handles MSP430 call ABI classification—16-bit scalar extension and indirect passing for aggregates larger than 32 bits—rather than inline-assembly register availability.
